q: Who issues a new corporate card to an employee?
answer:
The **Office & purchasing desk** issues corporate cards. It also stops and reissues them, and decides temporary limit raises.

The procurement area lists "getting a corporate card issued or cancelled" as a topic, and the desk's own document confirms the role. Contact details and cut-offs are in a separate page (`/v1/nodes/ga-contact/body`), which I didn't open.
